I'm developing a 3D bondage-oriented game focused on restraints, gags, tightness, and realistic submission dynamics.

Currently I'm working on Kinkystudio is a sandbox game where you can tie up, bind, restrain characters and take pictures. The project is not meant to be a full-scale game on its own, but rather a foundational platform to develop and test the core mechanics that will be reused and expanded in future projects. This includes interaction systems, character rigs, animation workflows, and tools that allow expressive, reactive characters in controlled scenarios.
